mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (1A2, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 3A4) which may reduce ginkgo biloba metabolism; ginkgo has antiplatelet/anticoagulant properties that may be potentiated, and cimetidine may inhibit platelet aggregation.
action: Monitor for increased bleeding risk and signs of bleeding; counsel patient on concurrent use; consider alternative H2 blocker (famotidine) if significant bleeding risk.
